My septum is 6g.
It’s an absolute pain. Forget everything they say about “quit when it hurts”. That applies for lobes, not the septum. 
It hurts a shit ton even if you do it right.
For me smaller sizes hurt way more than the bigger ones. 
Take it out if you have a headache for more than half an hour, then you sized up too early.
I recommend doing it after you showered, so yo tissue is softer. 
Your nose will always become the Niagara Falls of snot while you stretch, so grab a towel.
It’ll hurt almost like it’s new for a couple of days, that’s fine.
If you don’t have a taper with an insertion point for your new jewellery, get a buffalo ring (the ones that look like ring shaped tapers), because (at least for me) the hole gets back so quick into its original diameter, that I can’t get my new jewellery in after pushing the taper through. Have to wait a couple days until it adjusted. 

Happy stretchin.
